distractors.reason: 'Big' describes size. We don't say 'big subject' to mean the one you like most. Use 'favorite' for personal preference.
'Famous' means known by many people. We don't say 'famous subject' for a school subject.
'Tall' describes height. It cannot be used with 'subject' in this way.

example_sentence: Math is my ___ subject at school.
l1_interference: Україномовні учні часто шукають 'великий' або 'хороший' як переклад слова 'улюблений' і можуть сказати 'big subject' або 'good subject' замість правильного 'favorite subject'.
explanation: In English, 'favorite' is the adjective used to show personal preference for a school subject, color, food, or game. 'Favorite subject' means the subject you like most.

related_collocations.example: Math is a hard subject for me.
I got good grades in English.

memory_tip: FAVORITE = the one you like best (favorite subject, favorite color) | BIG = size (big house, big dog)
